seed.premise: Justin, a retired pirate running a quiet harbour café with Melissa, is pulled back toward his old crew the night a stolen map is about to be sold, and he can lose the café, Melissa's trust, or the chance to ever leave the sea behind.

cast.is: Justin's partner in the café, the one who gave him a quiet life on land
cast.wants: Justin to stay off the boats for good
cast.wound: Harrow ruined her family before, and she has never told anyone how
cast.secret: She borrowed money from Harrow to keep the café open, and it is coming due
cast.voice: Short sentences, dry humour, goes very quiet when she is angry

cast.is: Justin's old quartermaster, who still calls him Cap'n
cast.wants: Justin back at the helm of the Gull for one last job
cast.wound: The crew left her behind when the Gull was seized, and she never forgave them
cast.secret: She is the one who told Harrow where the map was hidden
cast.voice: Teasing, swears a lot, gets loud when she is hurt

cast.is: Justin's old navigator, the one who knows every chart and tide
cast.wants: To clear her debts, sell the map and vanish
cast.wound: Her brother died owing Harrow money
cast.secret: She already sold a copy of the map to Harrow
cast.voice: Talks fast, cracks jokes when nervous, deflects with puns

offscreen.name: Harrow
offscreen.is: The shipping man who owns the docks and is paying five thousand cash for the map

seed.collision: Candy needs Justin back at sea for one last job, while Melissa needs him on land and out of Harrow's reach, and the map sits between them.
seed.question: Can you ever really leave the life you lived, and do old loyalties outweigh a new one?

milestones.what: Harrow corners Melissa over the café loan, and the crew starts a fight at the docks that makes everything harder.
milestones.hinges_on: Whether Justin shields Melissa or takes the job to save the café.
milestones.if_a: He protects Melissa, Candy turns on him, and Harrow gets sharper.
milestones.if_b: He takes the job, Melissa's loan comes due, and the café is at risk.

milestones.what: Melissa's debt to Harrow comes out, and Ruby's secret sale of the map is revealed to have happened long before.
milestones.hinges_on: Whether Justin confronts Melissa or covers for her.
milestones.if_a: He confronts Melissa, trust breaks, and she leaves him the café.
milestones.if_b: He covers for her, and Candy and Ruby learn what he hid.

milestones.what: Harrow's midnight deadline arrives at the docks, and Candy's betrayal about the hidden map is exposed.
milestones.hinges_on: Whether Justin sails on the Gull or stays to face Harrow.
milestones.if_a: He sails, and Melissa is left alone with Harrow's debt.
milestones.if_b: He stays, the Gull sails without him, and Candy is lost to the sea.

milestones.what: Justin's final decision settles where the map ends up and which people he can live with.
milestones.hinges_on: Whether he hands the map to Harrow or destroys it.
milestones.if_a: Harrow gets the map, the crew breaks apart, and the café survives.
milestones.if_b: The map is destroyed, Harrow becomes an enemy, and the crew scatters.

planted.what: Ruby says she sold a copy, and the real map is in her boot
Melissa says Harrow has ruined people in this town before
Candy says the Gull is still tied up at the docks
Ruby admits Harrow already has her copy of the map

title: The Last Tide

steps.text: Twelve years since I last hoisted a black flag.
Cap'n. Don't look at me like that.
One night at sea, and Melissa runs this café alone.
Ruby sold the map. The buyers land at midnight.

choice.say: Ruby, what did you sell? Who to?

then.text: Relax. I sold a copy. The real one's in my boot.
You swore on the crew, Ruby. You swore.

choice.say: I'm done. Find someone else for the job.

then.text: Done? You were the best I ever sailed with.
Then I sell the map to the buyers myself.

steps.text: Wait. Ruby sold the map? Sold it to who?
Harrow. The shipping man who owns the docks.
Don't. Harrow's ruined people in this town before.
Harrow wants a job done. Five thousand cash, one night.
Five thousand. And what does the Cap'n get out of it?
Your old ship, the Gull, is still tied up at the docks.
Biscuit, our parrot, used to sit on that rail. Remember?

choice.say: Mel's right. I'm staying here with her.

then.text: Thank you. Then stop looking at that sea.
Keep him on land, then. See how long he lasts.

choice.say: Candy. Get the Gull ready, I'm coming.

then.text: Good. Ruby knows the tides, she'll pilot us.
You're going? Harrow will come after this café.

steps.text: Midnight, Cap'n. The buyers won't wait past the tide.

choice.t: I'm in. Give me the map.
choice.say: Fine. I'm in. Hand me the map.

then.text: Then don't you dare come back to this table.
Hold on. Ruby's been taking Harrow's money for a week.

choice.say: No. Harrow gets nothing from me.

then.text: Then you're out, Cap'n. For good this time.
Harrow already has my copy of the map. Did you know?

next: If Justin protects Melissa, Candy turns on him and Harrow's pressure grows at the docks.
If Justin takes the job to save the café, Melissa's debt to Harrow comes out and her trust breaks.
If Justin sails for the Gull at midnight, Candy's betrayal is exposed and Melissa is left alone with the debt.
If Justin hands the map to Harrow, the crew breaks apart and the café survives, but if he destroys it, Harrow becomes an enemy.
